description: Player housing interior system: room-based interior with furniture placement, interior decoration, and room types. Extends the existing BuildSystem and inventory with interior-specific items and a separate indoor space per player.
steps: Add new housing/furniture items to packages/shared/src/items.ts ItemId union: 'house_deed', 'table', 'chair', 'bed', 'lamp', 'bookshelf', 'rug', 'painting', 'plant_pot', 'window_curtain'. Add corresponding ITEM_DEFINITIONS entries (stackSize, displayName). Mark furniture items with a new 'placeable_furniture: true' property.
Add prices for new items in packages/shared/src/economy.ts ITEM_PRICES table. House deed costs 200 coins (one-time purchase). Furniture ranges from 15-80 coins with appropriate sell spread.

Create packages/game-engine/src/housing/housingDefinitions.ts defining: RoomType enum (living_room, bedroom, kitchen, study), RoomDefinition (id, size {width, height} in tiles, maxFurniture count, unlockCost coins), ROOM_DEFINITIONS record with 4 rooms, FurnitureDefinition (itemId, sizeInTiles, category).

Create packages/game-engine/src/housing/housingOps.ts with pure functions: canEnterHouse(inventory) checks for house_deed, createRoom(roomType) returns initial room state, placeFurniture(room, furnitureId, x, y) validates bounds/overlap and returns updated state, removeFurniture(room, slotIndex) returns item back, getRoomHappiness(room) calculates a happiness score (0-100) from furniture variety/count, canUnlockRoom(coins, roomType) checks unlock cost.

Create packages/game-engine/src/housing/housingState.ts with interfaces: HousingState (rooms: RoomState[], activeRoom: string|null, happiness: number), RoomState (type, furniture: PlacedFurniture[], unlocked: boolean), PlacedFurniture (itemId, x, y).

Create packages/game-engine/src/components/HousingComponent.ts with type 'housing', fields: state (HousingState), enterRequested (boolean), exitRequested (boolean), placeRequested ({roomId, itemId, x, y}|null), removeRequested ({roomId, index}|null), unlockRequested (string|null), version number.

Create packages/game-engine/src/systems/HousingSystem.ts processing entities with ['housing', 'inventory', 'wallet']. Handles enter/exit transitions, furniture placement (consumes item from inventory), removal (returns item to inventory), room unlocking (deducts coins from wallet). Validates all ops through pure functions.

Add housing-related i18n keys to all 12 locale files: housing.title, housing.enter, housing.exit, housing.room.*, housing.place, housing.remove, housing.happiness, housing.unlock, housing.noDeep (for house_deed needed message), room type names, furniture item names.

Add a new achievement in packages/game-engine/src/achievements/achievementDefinitions.ts: 'homeowner' (condition: {kind: 'housing_happiness', threshold: 50}). Add the new condition kind to AchievementCondition union and AchievementSource interface.
Export new components, system, and housing module from packages/game-engine/src/index.ts.

Write tests in packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/housing.test.ts covering: room creation, furniture placement (valid/invalid positions, bounds check, overlap check), furniture removal, happiness calculation, room unlocking with insufficient coins, enter/exit transitions, system integration with entity harness. At least 25 test cases.
Create apps/web/src/stores/housingStore.ts (Zustand) bridging HousingComponent state to React UI.
Create apps/web/src/components/HousingPanel.tsx showing room grid, placed furniture, furniture placement UI, room selector, happiness meter. Wire into GameUI.tsx with 'H' keybinding.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build passes with housing module compiled
pnpm test passes with at least 25 new housing tests
pnpm lint passes with no new warnings
All 12 locale files have new housing i18n keys
10 new furniture/housing items in the item catalogue
Happiness score correctly computed from furniture variety
findings: 1. The ITEM_NAME_KEYS record in apps/web/src/i18n/index.ts must be updated for every new item. 2. The SQL migration 004_authority_schema.sql must match ITEM_PRICES exactly. 3. French 'Table' is identical to English so item.table was added to LOCALE_AGNOSTIC_KEYS in i18n.test.ts. 4. The AchievementSystem now optionally reads HousingComponent for housingHappiness. 5. The packages/game-engine/src/index.ts barrel file was already over 300 lines before this change (382) - this is pre-existing.
